description:
Search Danish parliamentary cases/documents by text, date range, type, category, and topic. Category
            filters should usually be omitted for initial searches and used only for refinement.

case_type_id.description: Case type ID from the case type vocabulary resource.

category_id.description:
Advanced refinement filter. Use only when the user explicitly asks
        for this category or to narrow an already-inspected result set; categories are difficult to distinguish and
        should usually be omitted for initial searches.

from_date.description: Earliest update date, formatted as YYYY-MM-DD.

keyword_text.description: Natural-language topic text. Prefer this when exact keyword IDs are ambiguous.

query.description: Free-text query for case title, resume, explanation, or case number.

to_date.description: Latest update date, formatted as YYYY-MM-DD.

name: search_cases
